title: Assured Identity
description: Single canonical citizen-identity workflow. A public-org citizen submits a short 5-page wizard (name + DOB, address, contact, optional photo, review), a verification analyst (or background sorcha-agent) approves, and the AssuredIdentityCredential is delivered to the citizen's Sorcha wallet. Demo template: the issuing-agency name is injected via the {{issuerName}} token at provision time.
author: Sorcha Team

template.title: Assured Identity
template.description: Citizen submits identity details (including an optional portrait), a verification analyst reviews and issues an AssuredIdentityCredential, and the citizen claims the credential via a Wave 14b claim-card action.

metadata.features: HAIP, OpenID4VCI, Verifiable Credential, Portrait Claim, Citizen Claim Action, Core Primitives, x-review, x-file

participants.name: Citizen
participants.description: Submits an Assured Identity application and receives the credential in their Citizen Wallet PWA

participants.name: Verification Analyst
participants.description: Reviews citizen identity applications and approves issuance of the AssuredIdentityCredential

actions.title: Submit Assured Identity Application
actions.description: Citizen submits their personal details (and optionally a portrait photo) so a verification analyst can verify their identity. Fields are sourced from the Sorcha core primitive library for consistency with every other citizen-facing service. The final page renders the details as a DRAFT ID card so the citizen sees exactly what they'll receive once issued.

dataSchemas.x-introduction: Submit your details so a verification analyst can issue your Assured Identity credential. Your persona profile (if you have one) will prefill the form.

x-pages.title: About you
x-pages.description: Your full legal name and date of birth.

x-pages.title: Your address
x-pages.description: Your current registered address. Type your postcode and the rest will autofill where supported.

x-pages.title: Contact
x-pages.description: We'll only use your email for correspondence about this application.

x-pages.title: Your photo (optional)
x-pages.description: Add a portrait photo to your credential. This lets verifiers match you to your credential in person. You can skip this step — the credential is still issued without a photo.

x-pages.title: Review your details
x-pages.description: Check your answers. You can edit any section before submitting. Once the verification analyst approves, this is what your Assured Identity credential will show.

portrait.title: Portrait photo
portrait.description: Optional passport-style photograph. Captured via your device camera or uploaded; resized to a 240x320 JPEG token for embedding in the credential.

holderKeys.title: Identity keys
holderKeys.description: Your wallet's public delivery keys. Captured automatically and read-only — the credential is bound to your holder key and encrypted to your wallet so only you can use it. Feature 137 (cross-node submission).

actions.title: Verify Assured Identity Application
actions.description: Verification analyst reviews the citizen's submission and approves or rejects it. On approval the AssuredIdentityCredential is minted and routed to the citizen's Claim Credential action via OutputMapping.

dataSchemas.x-introduction: Review the citizen's submitted details and portrait (if provided) against your records. Approve to issue, or reject with a reason.

x-sections.title: Decision
x-sections.description: Approval state and supporting notes for the audit trail.

routes.description: Approved — deliver the minted credential to the citizen's Claim Credential pending action
Rejected — workflow ends with no credential issued

actions.title: Claim your Assured Identity credential
actions.description: Your Assured Identity credential is ready. Click Claim to deliver it to your Citizen Wallet PWA. Declining will cancel the claim and no credential will be issued.

credential_type.description: The credential type to be issued

expires_at.description: When the credential offer expires and can no longer be claimed

offer_id.description: HAIP offer identifier for status polling

claimed_at.title: Claimed at
claimed_at.description: Set by the client when the citizen clicks Claim
